title: Long-Stay Terms for Room Reservations Extra-Person Charges
content:
**Long-stay term.** Where an extra-person charge is added to a Room Reservations reservation, for a stay of at least a week of nights (7 nights) the charge is collected on the nights left after one free night for every full week, spread evenly over all nights of the stay; for a stay of at least 5 nights but less than a week that was booked at least 120 days before arrival, it is collected on every night but one, spread evenly over all nights of the stay; any other stay pays it on every night.

**Definitions.**

- *Stay* — the nights from the arrival date to the departure date on the reservation.
- *Booked before arrival* — the calendar days from the booked date to the arrival date.
- *Spread evenly* — the charge for each night is multiplied by the share of nights on which it is collected, that is the nights collected divided by all nights, as an exact fraction, so every night carries the same amount.

**Input — judgement — output.**

| Stay | Booked before arrival | Judgement | Share of nights collected |
|---|---|---|---|
| 21 nights | any | three full weeks, three free nights | 18 of 21 |
| 8 nights | any | one full week, one free night | 7 of 8 |
| 7 nights | any | one full week, one free night | 6 of 7 |
| 5 nights | 120 days | at least 5 nights, under a week, booked at least 120 days ahead | 4 of 5 |
| 5 nights | 119 days | booked fewer than 120 days ahead | every night |
| 4 nights | 200 days | fewer than 5 nights | every night |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** An extra-person charge of 35.00 for one night on an 8-night stay is 35.00 multiplied by 7 of 8, that is 30.625 per night before the nightly rate is rounded.
